dealer.mordaz.lines.bust: You busted. What a pity… not.
dealer.mordaz.lines.defeated: You haven't earned it. The Wall doesn't fall like I do.
The next one is stronger. And you can't beat it.
dealer.mordaz.lines.idle: Bet it all. Win and I'll give you double… lose and we'll see how I collect.
One all-in and everything is fixed. Or ended.
dealer.mordaz.lines.lose: Tell me that wasn't your best hand.
dealer.mordaz.lines.win: Enjoy it. It costs more than you think.
dealer.mordaz.name: Mordaz
dealer.muro.lines.defeated: This doesn't end. The game never ends, and we always win.
The next table shows no mercy.
dealer.muro.lines.idle: Take your time. I'm in no hurry.
dealer.muro.name: The Wall
dealer.pip.lines.defeated: That was a joke… the next one won't laugh!
Mordaz will undo you. I was only warming up.
dealer.pip.lines.idle: Hit me again, don't be boring!
One more little card never hurt, did it?
